prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Judy Choi, Walnut Central Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—case complexity, location, budget, and how much direct time you’ll get with the doctor all matter. A reasonable Dallas shortlist to compare is:

- **Dr. Benito Benitez, Dallas Orthodontics** — offers both braces and Invisalign; at **8510 Abrams Rd., Suite 508**.
- **Dr. Judy Choi, Walnut Central Orthodontics** — offers braces and Invisalign for children and adults; at **9669 N. Central Expressway, Suite 105**.
- **Dr. Nathan Harris** — listed in the American Association of Orthodontists’ locator; at **7001 Preston Rd., Suite 222**.
- **Dr. Bryan S. Elvebak** — also listed in the AAO locator; at **17300 Preston Rd., Suite 150**.

I’d book two or three consultations before deciding. Ask who will supervise your treatment, whether braces or Invisalign is better for *your* bite and goals, what’s included in the quoted fee (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. The AAO locator is a useful way to verify orthodontist credentials: [aaoinfo.org/locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
